description: LOCAL COPY of the hosted registered type (traced 2026-10-23); schema and required_fields transcribed, nothing authored.

outcome.description: RIPENED: the locked gates passed. PARTLY-RIPENED: some passed. RIPENED-DIFFERENTLY: gates fired but not the predicted ones — the study found something it did not predict, which is a result and not a rescue. FAIL: the gates failed cleanly, which is data. VOID: a precondition failed and the measurement is invalid, which is NOT an answer. HALTED: a Layer-1 violation, which overrides everything above.

void_reason.description: Required iff outcome is VOID. Names the failed precondition.

layer1_result.description: If violated, outcome MUST be HALTED regardless of any band.

prereg_sha256.description: The sealed prereg whose gates this verdict evaluates. Non-negotiable: without it the thresholds are unfalsifiable.

threshold_cited.description: The gate text copied verbatim from the sealed prereg, so a reader can check the band without opening another file.

retraction_ref.description: If this verdict retracts an earlier claim, the reference to that claim. Retraction events are authored at the moment of falsification, never reconstructed afterwards.
